questions.question: What should you do before using an AI assistant for work?
options: Check which tool your company has approved and how to sign in
Ask a colleague to share their login
Install several tools and compare them
questions.explanation: Step 1 says to confirm the company-approved tool, often a work account with stronger data protection, and never share logins.

questions.question: Why is the clearer team-lunch prompt better than 'Write about team lunch'?
options: It tells the assistant who it is for, what is needed and how long it should be
questions.explanation: The improved prompt gives the audience, purpose and length, the same things you would tell a new colleague.

questions.question: What does the Edit option let you do?
options: Ask the same question again to get a different version
Change a message you already sent and get a new reply from that point
questions.explanation: Edit changes a sent message and regenerates from there; retry (regenerate) is the one that simply asks again.

questions.question: When should you start a new chat?
options: When you switch to an unrelated task or the replies keep repeating an earlier mistake
questions.explanation: Long conversations collect old instructions that can confuse the assistant, so start fresh when switching tasks, repeating mistakes, or when the chat is very long.
